body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Radiant Damage and illuminate the target's space until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Ignore ordinary darkness for this attack.
On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Sprite
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 1 Mana to enter Sprite Full Manifestation (FM-0S). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
